reasoning: The dated fields contradict the sources and the claim's own reasons: both clause first_end dates and the whole_order_end are in 1958, before the order was signed (1961-02-17), while the reasons, savings text and rationale give 1961-06-20 and 1961-07-20. Identity, inventory, quotes, the cover ('JUNE 20, 1961', No. 135, names EO 10919 of February 17, 1961), the damaged letter line quoted as held ('June ~0~ 1961.') and the page image ('June 20, 1961') all check, so the cover-date rule applies and is corroborated. EO 10926 (1961-03-18) is correctly a later event that moved the deadline to June 20, 1961; the report is dated that day. Standstill arithmetic in the reasons: 1961-06-20 + 30 = 1961-07-20 (exclusive 1961-07-19). Both OFR notes (amended by EO 10926, revoked by EO 12553) are addressed; EO 12553 has no savings wording. Note (not a defect): the report source's page_or_item is the held text's range 'PDF pages 1-8' although the cited span lies on PDF pages 1-2.
